newsitem.title: UK: LME copper prices little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper prices little changed in late trading.

text.p: Copper prices held steady in late trading on Thursday as the market looked ahead to Friday's London Metal Exchange (LME) stock data.
At 1900 GMT three months delivery copper was at $2,236/40 per tonne, a couple of dollars up from the its kerb close. Aluminium was virtually unchanged at $1,606/08.
Copper prices have drifted lower following Wedenesday's spurt to 8-1/2 year highs on Wednesday.
"Copper seems to have run out of steam," said analyst William Adams of broker Rudolf Wolff, adding that producer forward selling and buying of puts had been seen.
Traders would closely watch stocks data on Friday, the first since the February prompt date. LME inventories were expected to see a modest fall, traders said.
